summary.text: Joyce Waddell is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 40 since January 2015 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is an educator who previously served on the Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Joyce Waddell is a graduate of South Carolina State University and holds a master's degree from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte, North Carolina A&T State University and Appalachian State University, according to Ballotpedia, and she earned her doctorate from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro.

She has three decades of experience in education, including 21 years in Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools as a teacher and administrator, and has served on more than 15 boards and community organizations.
Waddell served on the Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools Board of Education, District 3, until 2015, and assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2015.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Appropriations on Education/Higher Education, Appropriations/Base Budget, Health Care, Rules and Operations of the Senate, Finance, and Pensions and Retirement and Aging.

In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, she listed a strong economy that promotes widespread growth as a top priority and wrote that the state's minimum wage of $7.25 "does not provide enough income for impoverished families to survive on."
